name: Qi4D Max
description: The ultimate in forgiveness. Qi4D Max features an ultra-low CG and max MOI for stability.

descriptions.en: The ultimate in forgiveness. Qi4D Max features an ultra-low CG and max MOI for stability.
descriptions.ko: 궁극의 관용성. Qi4D Max는 초저중심 설계와 최대 MOI로 뛰어난 안정성을 제공합니다.

name: Qi4D LS
description: Low Spin model with adjustable sliding weight track. Designed for high swing speeds.

descriptions.en: Low Spin model with adjustable sliding weight track. Designed for high swing speeds.
descriptions.ko: 슬라이딩 웨이트 트랙이 적용된 저스핀 모델. 빠른 스윙 스피드를 가진 골퍼를 위해 설계되었습니다.

name: Qi4D Max Lite
description: Ultra-lightweight construction for moderate swing speeds. Easy launch and maximum carry.

descriptions.en: Ultra-lightweight construction for moderate swing speeds. Easy launch and maximum carry.
descriptions.ko: 중간 스윙 스피드를 위한 초경량 설계. 쉬운 탄도와 최대 비거리를 제공합니다.

name: Quantum Max
description: Callaway Quantum Max uses Ai Smart Face 2.0 for consistent speed across the entire face.

descriptions.en: Callaway Quantum Max uses Ai Smart Face 2.0 for consistent speed across the entire face.
descriptions.ko: 캘러웨이 퀀텀 맥스는 Ai 스마트 페이스 2.0을 사용하여 페이스 전체에서 일관된 스피드를 제공합니다.

name: Quantum Triple Diamond
description: Compact, low-spin head for elite players seeking workability and precision.

descriptions.en: Compact, low-spin head for elite players seeking workability and precision.
descriptions.ko: 조작성과 정밀함을 추구하는 엘리트 플레이어를 위한 컴팩트한 저스핀 헤드.

name: Quantum Triple Diamond Max
description: The perfect blend of workability and forgiveness. Slightly larger footprint than the standard Triple Diamond.

descriptions.en: The perfect blend of workability and forgiveness. Slightly larger footprint than the standard Triple Diamond.
descriptions.ko: 조작성과 관용성의 완벽한 조화. 표준 트리플 다이아몬드보다 약간 더 큰 헤드 형상.

name: G440 Max
description: Ping's straightest driver ever. G440 Max pushes MOI to the limit for unmatched stability.

descriptions.en: Ping's straightest driver ever. G440 Max pushes MOI to the limit for unmatched stability.
descriptions.ko: 핑 역사상 가장 똑바로 가는 드라이버. G440 Max는 비교할 수 없는 안정성을 위해 MOI를 극한까지 끌어올렸습니다.

name: G440 LST
description: Low Spin Technology model. Smaller head profile for lower launch and spin.

descriptions.en: Low Spin Technology model. Smaller head profile for lower launch and spin.
descriptions.ko: 저스핀 기술(Low Spin Technology) 모델. 더 낮은 탄도와 스핀을 위한 작은 헤드 프로파일.

name: OPTM Max
description: Cobra OPTM Max features advanced aerodynamics and optimized weighting for effortless speed.

descriptions.en: Cobra OPTM Max features advanced aerodynamics and optimized weighting for effortless speed.
descriptions.ko: 코브라 OPTM Max는 진보된 공기역학 설계와 최적화된 무게 배분으로 손쉬운 스피드를 제공합니다.

name: OPTM LS
description: Low spin version of the OPTM line. Forward weighting for penetrating ball flight.

descriptions.en: Low spin version of the OPTM line. Forward weighting for penetrating ball flight.
descriptions.ko: OPTM 라인의 저스핀 버전. 관통하는 탄도를 위한 전방 무게 배분.
